standard_prerequisites.name: Exhaustiveness of derivability
standard_prerequisites.statement: For any Gamma and A, either Gamma union {A} or Gamma union {not-A} is consistent (the derivability relation is exhaustive).
standard_prerequisites.use: The contradiction horn in the consistency induction: if both extensions were inconsistent, Gamma_n itself would be, against the induction hypothesis.

standard_prerequisites.name: Compactness of derivability
standard_prerequisites.statement: If every finite subset of Gamma is consistent then Gamma is consistent.
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the per-stage consistency to the union Gamma* via its finite subsets.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2005-2009): every consistent set Gamma extends to a complete consistent Gamma*.

Construction (proof lines 2011-2022): enumerate the sentences A_0, A_1, ...; Gamma_0 = Gamma; Gamma_{n+1} = Gamma_n union {A_n} if that is consistent, else Gamma_n union {not A_n}; Gamma* is the union of the chain.

Consistency induction (proof lines 2024-2038): each Gamma_n is consistent - the failure case would make both extensions inconsistent, hence Gamma_n inconsistent by exhaustiveness, against the induction hypothesis.
Chain monotonicity (proof lines 2040-2052): Gamma_i subseteq Gamma_n for i < n by induction on n with transitivity of the subset relation.

Consistency of the union (proof lines 2054-2067): every finite Gamma' inside Gamma* sits inside some Gamma_n (largest-index argument), so is consistent; compactness of derivability gives Gamma* consistent.
Completeness (proof lines 2069-2075): every sentence appears on the list; if A_n not in Gamma* then Gamma_n union {A_n} was inconsistent, so not-A_n is in Gamma*.
proof_roadmap: Enumerate the sentences and build the chain by the consistency test.
Prove each stage consistent by induction, using exhaustiveness in the else case.
Push consistency up to the union through finite subsets and compactness, then read completeness off the construction.
difficulty_reason: Lindenbaum extension (statement 2005-2009, proof 2011-2075): the complete construction with both the consistency induction (via exhaustiveness) and the finite-subset argument for the union (via compactness of derivability) carried in span. H3.
